_: The royal seal (seals.js; King of Dragon Pass's actions a season): every order the King gives takes a seal as well as its gold, a chronicle matter's order too; saying no, sitting a war out and a petition's answer at court take none. on: the default for a reign that doesn't say (its options.seals). perSeason seals come with each season, kept up to bank (bankLastAct in the last act). perSeason 1 with an 80 s season and a matter every 45 s: he can act on about half the matters; the rest he sits out or lets lapse (Mac 2026-11-16: 'I can take any action').
